rule_or_requirement: Find pixel-only high-speed recovery mechanisms that visibly change steering or speed while preserving qualified finish-line crossing.
observable_information: Current and recent 84x84 grayscale frames, rendered road centers, bright visible objects, pixel speed bar, inherited action, and TRAIN-only evaluation traces.
allowed_action_or_state_change: Four frozen interventions respectively add road-loss memory, bend-exit target, obstacle-side passage, and curvature-coupled speed budget around the speed-coupled reference.
expected_success_endpoint: Each direction activates on TRAIN and does not introduce invalid actions; completion of the two TRAIN cells is diagnostic only.
control: Exact selected full-road-guard checkpoint runtime in the registered benchmark.
falsifier: Any direction never changes an action, emits an invalid action, or loses a control-completed TRAIN cell; no new tune cells are opened for failed directions.
smallest_decisive_experiment: Five profiles on already designated TRAIN cells 1:43 and 2:102, ten episodes total, at most 2000 decisions per episode.
resource_and_risk_gate: Registered local diagnostic profile in Linux Python 3.11 CPU, 2 CPUs, 2 GiB and 1800 seconds; no external action or SOTA promotion.
